msg.sender supplies the debited balance owner inside transfer.
_to parameter flows into transfer to select the credited balance entry.
_value parameter flows into transfer as the amount moved.
transfer evaluates the balances[_to] + _value addition guarded against overflow.

_value is added to the recipient balance.

balances mapping is updated by the addition operation.

balances mapping is updated by the subtraction in transferFrom.
